contract.status: PB1 neutral contract; planned experimental work; not ratified; not part of Brontide Base

taxonomyRule: The protocol categories, process categories, and failure domains below are reproduced from conformance/channel-0.1-vectors.json and must remain exactly that set. This contract adds no category and removes none.

fields.name: contractVersion
fields.rule: A value the endpoint does not recognize is 'unsupported-version'.

fields.name: requestId
fields.rule: Required for request, outcome, and any protocol-error correlated to a request.

envelopeKinds.body: negotiated contract acknowledgement and assigned compact identifiers

envelopeKinds.note: Neither experiment had an explicit readiness signal; C8 requires one because no provider effect may occur before readiness.

envelopeKinds.body: operation reference, input value, and declared resources
succeeded result value or failed detail value
portable category and non-normative local code

notAnEnvelopeKind.reason: A local authority denial emits no frame (CH-12-DENIAL-IS-NOT-A-FRAME). It is an observation with frameDecision 'none' and resultClass 'denial'.
notAnEnvelopeKind.presentIn: the Cooling experiment, whose denial is emitted by the provider-side host adapter after the frame boundary
notAnEnvelopeKind.migration: PB2 and PB3 must not carry the Cooling denial kind into the portable envelope set.

notAnEnvelopeKind.reason: Process loss is observed locally, not signalled. It has frameDecision 'none' and resultClass 'process-failure'.

messageKindMapping.purpose: Maps each message kind PB0 inventoried to the neutral envelope kind and the governing Channel vector, closing the C4 'fixture-specific' classification.

correlation.identityRule: Channel correlation identities are opaque and never equal host-native Execution or Occurrence identities.

identities.scope: one request; carried only when the peer echoes it

rules.case: the outcome echoes every carried identity
the outcome carries a requestId the host did not send
a required correlation identity is absent
an accepted requestId reappears inside the declared replay window

correlation.hostNativeMappingRule: The host records a distinct host-native Execution identity for each accepted outcome and reports the correlation mapping as a C9 observation.

protocolErrorCategories.detail: Required envelope fields absent or malformed, or an encoding rule violated. No foreign parser exception crosses.
A declared contract or envelope version the endpoint does not recognize.
An unrecognized contract, required feature, Shape, Fragment, dependency, or resource flavor.
A structurally valid envelope whose kind or body discriminator is unknown.
A request naming an Operation outside the established contract.
A claimed outcome whose correlation identities do not match an outstanding request.
An input that cannot conform through permitted payload projection, including a refused resource and an integrity mismatch.
A Capability crossing a trust boundary, a missing no-capability-transfer declaration, or a constraint policy other than fail-closed.
A repeated requestId inside the declared replay window.
An inbound frame or value exceeding a declared bound.
A recognized kind that is illegal in the current lifecycle state.
The endpoint cannot continue protocol processing. No exception, stack trace, or runtime type crosses.

processFailureCategories.detail: Retains the reason narrower attribution was impossible.

failureSeparation.rule: Semantic failure, protocol rejection, process loss, and local denial remain four distinct observations.

distinctions.detail: The Operation reported structured failure details in its declared detail Shape. Result is absent. This is not a protocol or process failure.

noExceptionTransport.rule: No private exception, stack trace, runtime type name, or authority object crosses the seam in any of the four observations.

localCodeRule.rule: An endpoint may carry a local diagnostic code alongside the portable category. Local code strings are non-normative and never drive portable semantics.
